values.binNote: ShieldCapBase [200/300/400] holds the total-shield cap; the wiki's Initial Shield (2 instances) equals ShieldCapBase/5 = 40/60/80, and its AD ratio equals the total ratio (3xbonusAd) /5 = 0.6xbonusAd. No bin row stores the initial-instance value directly.

Per-instance shield equals ShieldCapBase/10 = 20/30/40 (matching the 0.25s-tick, 2s-cap structure); its AD ratio equals the total ratio (3xbonusAd)/10 = 0.3xbonusAd. No bin row stores the per-instance value directly.

mechanics.claim: The dash deals damage exactly once, when it collides with the first visible enemy champion in its path, then ends the charge.
mechanics.quote: colliding with the first visible enemy champion in their path to deal {{as|magic damage}}

mechanics.claim: The collision damage scales up with time spent charging before the dash began, capped at 4 seconds of charge time (8% per 0.16s).
mechanics.quote: increased by {{pp|type=charge time|key=%|label=Damage Increase|0 to 200 for 26|0 to 4|formula=8% increase per 0.16 seconds. ''This is capped at 4 seconds of time active.''}}

mechanics.claim: The shield builds up every 0.25 seconds of charging up to a cap at 2 seconds of travel, and lasts 2 seconds once the charge finishes.
mechanics.quote: plus an additional amount for every {{fd|0.25}} seconds of traveling, up to a cap at 2 seconds. The shield lasts for 2 seconds upon finishing the charge.

mechanics.claim: If the charge ends before or during the dash, no shield is generated.
mechanics.quote:
If the charge ends before, or during the dash, the dash will not:
** Generate a shield;
